sentences.text: woman : Jack, I'm thinking of taking the kids to the seaside on a surfing holiday this summer and I wanted to ask your advice – as I know you're such an expert.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 杰克，我正考虑今年夏天带孩子们去海边度过一个冲浪假期，想听听你的建议——毕竟我知道你可是这方面的专家。

sentences.text: jack : Well, I don't know about that, but yes, I've done a bit of surfing over the years.
sentences.zh: JACK: 呃，我可不敢当什么专家，不过确实这些年断断续续冲过几次浪。

sentences.text: I'd thoroughly recommend it.
sentences.zh: 我非常推荐这种度假方式。

sentences.text: I think it's the kind of holiday all the family can enjoy together .
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是全家人都能一起享受的假期类型。

sentences.text: The thing about surfing is that it's great for all ages and all abilities.
sentences.zh: 冲浪的好处在于，它适合所有年龄段和各种水平的人。

sentences.text: My youngest started when he was only three!
sentences.zh: 我最小的孩子三岁就开始学了！

sentences.text: woman : Wow!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哇！

sentences.text: But it's quite physically demanding, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 但这对体力要求挺高的，对吧？

sentences.text: I've heard you need to be pretty fit .
sentences.zh: 我听说你得有相当好的体能才行。

sentences.text: jack : Yes.
sentences.zh: JACK: 是的。

sentences.text: You'll certainly learn more quickly and won't tire as easily.
sentences.zh: 你肯定学得更快，而且不容易感到疲劳。

sentences.text: woman : Well – that should be OK for us.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯——那对我们来说应该没问题。

sentences.text: You've been surfing a few times in Ireland, haven't you?
sentences.zh: 你在爱尔兰冲过几次浪，对吧？

sentences.text: jack : Yes.
sentences.zh: JACK: 对。

sentences.text: There's some great surfing there, which people don't always realise.
sentences.zh: 那里有不少很棒的冲浪点，只是人们往往没意识到这一点。

sentences.text: woman : And which locations would you recommend? – there seem to be quite a few .
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那你推荐哪些地点呢？——看起来选择还挺多的。

sentences.text: jack : Yes, there are loads.
sentences.zh: JACK: 是啊，选择非常多。

sentences.text: Last year we went to County Donegal.
sentences.zh: 去年我们去了多尼戈尔郡。

sentences.text: There are several great places to surf there.
sentences.zh: 那里有好几个绝佳的冲浪地点。

sentences.text: woman : What about in County Clare?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 克莱尔郡呢？

sentences.text: I read that's also really good for surfing.
sentences.zh: 我读到那里也很适合冲浪。

sentences.text: jack : Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: JACK: 没错，确实如此。

sentences.text: I've been there a few times.
sentences.zh: 我去过好几次。

sentences.text: Most people go to Lahinch.
sentences.zh: 大多数人都会去莱欣奇。

sentences.text: My kids love it there.
sentences.zh: 我孩子特别喜欢那儿。

sentences.text: The waves aren't too challenging and the town is very lively.
sentences.zh: 那里的海浪难度不太高，而且小镇氛围非常活跃。

sentences.text: woman : Are there good hotels there?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那边有不错的酒店吗？

sentences.text: jack : Yes – some very nice ones and there are also a few basic hostels and campsites.
sentences.zh: JACK: 有——有些非常棒的酒店，另外还有几家基础型青年旅舍和露营地。

sentences.text: It's great if you need lessons as the surf schools are excellent.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要上课，那里就更理想了，因为冲浪学校非常出色。

sentences.text: woman : Sounds good.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 听起来不错。

sentences.text: jack : Yes and there's lots to see in the area – like those well-known cliffs – …
sentences.zh: JACK: 是啊，而且当地还有很多景点可看——比如那些著名的悬崖……

sentences.text: I've forgotten the name of them …
sentences.zh: 我一时想不起它们的名字了……

sentences.text: woman : Oh don't worry – I can look them up.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦别担心，我可以自己查一下。

sentences.text: jack : I've also been surfing in County Mayo, which is less well-known for surfing, but we had a really good time.
sentences.zh: JACK: 我还在梅奥郡冲过浪，虽然那里不太以冲浪闻名，但我们玩得非常尽兴。

sentences.text: That was a few years ago when the kids were younger.
sentences.zh: 那是几年前的事了，当时孩子们还小一些。

sentences.text: There's a good surf school at Carrowniskey beach.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尼斯基海滩有一家不错的冲浪学校。

sentences.text: woman : How do you spell that?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那个名字怎么拼？

sentences.text: jack : C-A-double R-O-W-N-I-S-K-E-Y woman : OK.
sentences.zh: JACK: C-A-双R-O-W-N-I-S-K-E-Y。WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.text: jack : I put the kids into the surf camp they run during the summer for 10–16 year olds.
sentences.zh: JACK: 我把孩子们送进了他们暑期举办的冲浪营，面向10至16岁的青少年。

sentences.text: woman : Oh right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，明白了。

sentences.text: How long was that for?
sentences.zh: 那次持续了多久？

sentences.text: jack : Three hours every day for a week.
sentences.zh: 杰克：每天三小时，持续一周。

sentences.text: It was perfect – they were so tired out after that.
sentences.zh: 那简直完美——孩子们之后累坏了。

sentences.text: woman : I can imagine.
sentences.zh: 女士：我能想象。

sentences.text: jack : One thing we did while the kids were surfing was to rent some kayaks to have a look around the bay which is nearby.
sentences.zh: 杰克：孩子们冲浪时，我们做的一件事是租了几艘皮划艇，在附近的海湾转了一圈。

sentences.text: It's really beautiful.
sentences.zh: 那里真的很美。

sentences.text: woman : Oh, I'd love to do that.
sentences.zh: 女士：哦，我真想试试。

sentences.text: woman : Now the only time I went to Ireland it rained practically every day.
sentences.zh: 女士：我唯一一次去爱尔兰，几乎天天都在下雨。

sentences.text: jack : Mmm yes – that can be a problem – but you can surf in the rain, you know.
sentences.zh: 杰克：嗯，是啊——这可能是个问题——但你知道，下雨天也能冲浪。

sentences.text: woman : It doesn't have the same appeal, somehow.
sentences.zh: 女士：不知怎的，那样就少了几分吸引力。

sentences.text: jack : Well, the weather's been fine the last couple of years when I've been there, but actually, it tends to rain more in August than in the spring or autumn.
sentences.zh: 杰克：嗯，过去几年我去的时候天气一直不错；不过实际上，八月的降雨量通常比春季或秋季更多。

sentences.text: September's my favourite month because the water is warmer then.
sentences.zh: 九月是我最喜欢的月份，因为那时海水更暖和。

sentences.text: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts woman : The only problem is that the kids are back to school then.
sentences.zh: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 听力原文 女士：唯一的问题是，那时孩子们已经返校上课了。

sentences.text: jack : I know.
sentences.zh: 杰克：我知道。

sentences.text: But one good thing about Irish summers is that it doesn't get too hot.
sentences.zh: 但爱尔兰夏季的一个好处是，天气不会太热。

sentences.text: The average temperature is about 19 degrees and it usually doesn't go above degrees.
sentences.zh: 平均气温约为19摄氏度，通常不会超过这个温度。

sentences.text: woman : That sounds alright.
sentences.zh: 女士：听起来还不错。

sentences.text: Now what about costs?
sentences.zh: 那么费用方面呢？

sentences.text: jack : Surfing is a pretty cheap holiday really – the only cost is the hire of equipment.
sentences.zh: 杰克：冲浪其实是一种相当便宜的度假方式——唯一的花费就是租用装备。

sentences.text: You can expect to pay a daily rate of about 30 euros for the hire of a wetsuit and board – but you can save about 40 euros if you hire by the week.
sentences.zh: 租用一套潜水服和冲浪板，每天大约需支付30欧元；但如果按周租赁，可节省约40欧元。

sentences.text: woman : That's not too bad.
sentences.zh: 女士：这还不算太贵。

sentences.text: jack : No.
sentences.zh: 杰克：是啊。

sentences.text: It's important to make sure you get good quality wetsuits – you'll all get too cold if you don't.
sentences.zh: 重要的是确保租到高质量的潜水服——否则大家都会觉得太冷。

sentences.text: And make sure you also get boots.
sentences.zh: 还要确保同时租到潜水靴。

sentences.text: They keep your feet warm and it's easier to surf with them on too.
sentences.zh: 它们能让你的双脚保持温暖，而且穿着它们冲浪也更容易。

sentences.text: woman : OK.
sentences.zh: 女士：好的。

sentences.text: Well, thanks very much …
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢……

sentences.text: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.text: My name's Mrs Carter and I run the before and after school extended hours childcare service.
sentences.zh: 我叫卡特夫人，负责运营本校的课前与课后延时托管服务。

sentences.text: I hope you've had a chance to have a good look around the school and talk to staff and pupils.
sentences.zh: 希望各位已有机会仔细参观学校，并与教职工及学生进行了交流。

sentences.text: I know that many of you are interested in using our childcare service when your child joins the school, and perhaps you already know something about it, but for those that don't, I'll go through the main details now.
sentences.zh: 我知道在座许多家长都希望孩子入学后使用我们的托管服务，或许您已对此有所了解；但对尚不熟悉的朋友，我现在将为大家介绍主要细节。

sentences.text: We offer childcare for children from the ages of four to eleven both before and after school.
sentences.zh: 我们为四至十一岁的儿童提供课前与课后的托管服务。

sentences.text: I know that many parents who work find this service invaluable.
sentences.zh: 我知道，许多在职家长发现这项服务极为宝贵。

sentences.text: You can leave your child with us safe in the knowledge that they will be extremely well cared for.
sentences.zh: 您可以放心地把孩子交给我们，因为他们将得到极佳的照护。

sentences.text: We are insured to provide care for up to 70 children, although we rarely have this many attending at any one session.
sentences.zh: 我们投保的服务容量为最多70名儿童，尽管实际上每次活动很少达到这一人数。

sentences.text: I think we generally expect around 50–60 children for the afternoon sessions and about half that number for the breakfast sessions .
sentences.zh: 我想下午场次一般有50至60名儿童参加，而早餐场次人数约为其一半。

sentences.text: Although we currently do have 70 children registered with us, not all of these attend every day.
sentences.zh: 虽然目前我们登记在册的儿童已达70名，但并非所有儿童每天都来。

sentences.text: It's ten years since we began offering an extended hours service and we've come a long way during that time.
sentences.zh: 我们开展延时托管服务已有十年，这些年取得了长足发展。

sentences.text: When we first opened, we only had about 20 children attending regularly .
sentences.zh: 刚开办时，仅有约20名儿童定期参加。

sentences.text: We try to keep our costs as low as we can and we think we provide very good value for money.
sentences.zh: 我们努力将成本控制在最低水平，并认为所提供的服务物有所值。

sentences.text: For the afternoon sessions, which run from 3.30 until 6 p.m., it's £7.20.
sentences.zh: 下午场次从下午3:30持续至下午6:00，费用为7.20英镑。

sentences.text: But if you prefer, you can pay for one hour only, which costs £3.50, or two hours which costs £5.70.
sentences.zh: 但如果您愿意，您也可以仅支付一小时的费用，为3.50英镑；或两小时，为5.70英镑。

sentences.text: The cost of the childcare includes food and snacks.
sentences.zh: 儿童看护费用包含食物和点心。

sentences.text: They'll be given breakfast in the morning and in the afternoon, a healthy snack as soon as they finish school.
sentences.zh: 孩子们早上会享用早餐，下午放学后会立即提供一份健康点心。

sentences.text: At 5 p.m. children are given something more substantial, such as pasta or a casserole.
sentences.zh: 下午5点，孩子们会享用一份更丰盛的食物，例如意大利面或炖菜。

sentences.text: Please inform us of any allergies that your child might have and we'll make sure they're offered a suitable alternative.
sentences.zh: 请务必告知我们您的孩子是否有任何过敏情况，我们将确保为其提供合适的替代餐食。

sentences.text: As you may know, the childcare service runs through the school holidays from 8 a.m. to p.m.
sentences.zh: 如您所知，儿童看护服务在学假期间照常运行，时间为上午8点至下午（原文未明确结束时间）。

sentences.text: We offer a really varied and exciting programme to keep the children entertained – we don't want them to feel as if they are still at school!
sentences.zh: 我们提供内容丰富且富有吸引力的活动项目，以确保孩子们玩得开心——我们不希望他们感觉好像仍在学校上课！

sentences.text: It will also feel different because they'll get the chance to make new friends with children from other schools – spaces are available for them because a lot of our term-time children don't always attend during the holiday.
sentences.zh: 活动氛围也会有所不同，因为他们将有机会结识来自其他学校的新朋友——由于我们学期中许多孩子在假期期间并不总是参加，因此名额对这些孩子是开放的。

sentences.text: In the past, parents have asked if children over the age of 11 are allowed to come with their younger brothers and sisters – but I'm afraid we're unable to do this because of the type of insurance we have.
sentences.zh: 过去，曾有家长询问：11岁以上的孩子是否可以陪同年幼的弟弟妹妹一同参加？但很抱歉，由于我们所投保的保险类型限制，我们无法允许这样做。

sentences.text: So now let me tell you about some of the activities that your child can do during the after- school sessions.
sentences.zh: 接下来，让我为您介绍一下您的孩子在课后托管期间可参与的部分活动。

sentences.text: As well as being able to use the playground equipment, computers and /12 /12 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129
sentences.zh: 除了可以使用游乐场设施、电脑以及……

sentences.text: holly : Hello Dr Green – I'm here to talk to you about my work placement.
sentences.zh: HOLLY：您好，格林博士，我今天来是想跟您谈谈我的实习安排。

sentences.text: tutor : Oh yes, it's Holly, isn't it?
sentences.zh: TUTOR：哦，对了，你是霍莉，没错吧？

sentences.text: holly : Yes.
sentences.zh: HOLLY：是的。

sentences.text: tutor : So, which work placement have you chosen?
sentences.zh: TUTOR：那么，您选择的是哪项实习安排呢？

sentences.text: holly : I decided to go for the Orion Stadium placement.
sentences.zh: HOLLY：我决定选择奥赖恩体育场的实习岗位。

sentences.text: The event I'll be managing is one where I'm helping to set up a sports competition for primary school children.
sentences.zh: 我将负责组织一场面向小学生的体育竞赛活动。

sentences.text: tutor : Yup.
sentences.zh: TUTOR：嗯。

sentences.text: That's always a popular placement – even though it can be tougher than you think working with children.
sentences.zh: 这向来是一个颇受欢迎的实习岗位——尽管与儿童共事的实际难度可能超出您的预期。

sentences.text: holly : I know, but it's the fresh air that attracts me – organising something indoors doesn't have the same appeal, even though it might be fun.
sentences.zh: HOLLY：我知道，但真正吸引我的是户外的新鲜空气——室内活动的组织工作虽可能有趣，却缺乏同样的吸引力。

sentences.text: tutor : OK, so obviously safety's going to be one of your key concerns for this event.
sentences.zh: TUTOR：好的，那么显然，本次活动的安全问题将是您的首要关切之一。

sentences.text: holly : Yes, I've already thought about that.
sentences.zh: HOLLY：是的，这一点我已提前考虑过了。

sentences.text: I'll need to make sure none of the equipment's damaged.
sentences.zh: 我需要确保所有器材均无损坏。

sentences.text: tutor : Ah well, you'll be working with schools, so the equipment will be their responsibility.
sentences.zh: TUTOR：啊，不过您将与各所学校合作，因此器材本身由校方负责。

sentences.text: However, the grounds and what goes on there will be yours.
sentences.zh: 然而，场地及其上开展的所有活动则由您负责。

sentences.text: holly : Oh I see – that'll include keeping everyone within the boundary once they're in their kit and on the field?
sentences.zh: HOLLY：哦，我明白了——也就是说，一旦孩子们换好运动服进入场地，我就需确保所有人始终留在划定区域内？

sentences.text: tutor : Exactly – you'll need to inspect areas like changing rooms as well for anything someone can trip over, but your main priority will be not to lose anyone!
sentences.zh: TUTOR：完全正确——您还需检查更衣室等区域，排除可能导致人员绊倒的隐患，但您的首要任务是绝不能让任何人走失！

sentences.text: holly : Right.
sentences.zh: HOLLY：明白。

sentences.text: I'll need staff to help with that.
sentences.zh: 我需要工作人员协助完成这项工作。

sentences.text: tutor : And don't forget about the spectators.
sentences.zh: TUTOR：另外，别忘了观众。

sentences.text: holly : Mmm.
sentences.zh: HOLLY：嗯。

sentences.text: I was thinking that many of them will be parents, who could help run the event.
sentences.zh: 我在想，其中很多观众会是孩子的家长，或许能协助活动运行。

sentences.text: tutor : I wouldn't rely on that.
sentences.zh: TUTOR：我不建议您依赖这一点。

sentences.text: They'll be more interested in filming their children than volunteering.
sentences.zh: 他们更热衷于拍摄自己孩子的影像，而非主动提供志愿服务。

sentences.text: holly : I'll need to make sure they don't interfere with events doing that!
sentences.zh: HOLLY：我必须确保他们不会因拍摄而干扰活动进程！

sentences.text: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts tutor : And that's not always easy, especially when a proud parent's trying to get a snap of their child and you want them to move elsewhere.
sentences.zh: TUTOR：这并非易事，尤其当一位自豪的家长正努力抓拍自己孩子的瞬间，而您却需要请他移步至其他位置时。

sentences.text: holly : OK.
sentences.zh: HOLLY：好的。

sentences.text: What about the scheduling?
sentences.zh: 那么关于日程安排呢？

sentences.text: tutor : With sporting events there are all sorts of things that can alter the timetable – like rain, for instance – though so far, we've always been lucky with that.
sentences.zh: TUTOR：体育赛事存在诸多可能影响时间表的因素——例如降雨——不过到目前为止，我们在天气方面一直很幸运。

sentences.text: holly : Yeah, and I was thinking about what to do if someone got hurt as well.
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 是啊，我也在考虑如果有人受伤了该怎么办。

sentences.text: I know that last year that caused a terrible delay.
sentences.zh: 我知道去年这就造成了严重的延误。

sentences.text: tutor : You have to be prepared for such things.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 你必须为这类事情做好准备。

sentences.text: holly : Oh.
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 哦。

sentences.text: What if a match ends in a draw – do you let the teams keep going until someone wins?
sentences.zh: 如果一场比赛以平局结束，你们是让两支队伍继续比赛直到分出胜负吗？

sentences.text: tutor : That'll be up to you – and again, you need to plan for it.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 这将由你来决定——而且同样地，你也需要为此提前规划。

sentences.text: holly : Right.
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 明白了。

sentences.text: tutor : Now, the aim of your work placement is to give you the opportunity to develop the skills that an events manager needs.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 现在，你这次实习工作的目标是为你提供机会，培养一名活动经理所需具备的各项技能。

sentences.text: So, let's talk about those a bit.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们来稍微谈一谈这些技能。

sentences.text: holly : Well, I think my communication skills are pretty good.
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 嗯，我觉得我的沟通能力相当不错。

sentences.text: I can talk on the phone to people and book venues and that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 我可以打电话与人交流、预订场地之类的事情。

sentences.text: tutor : Good – just remember it isn't only about what you say.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 很好——但请记住，这并不仅仅关乎你说什么。

sentences.text: If you meet someone face-to-face and want to persuade them to be a sponsor, for example …
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你要面对面会见某人，并想说服对方成为赞助商……

sentences.text: holly : Oh, I'll dress up for that!
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 哦，我会为此精心着装的！

sentences.text: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.text: tutor : Good.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 很好。

sentences.text: Let's go on to think about your organisational skills.
sentences.zh: 我们接着来谈谈你的组织协调能力。

sentences.text: You're working in a very people-based industry and that means things won't always go to plan.
sentences.zh: 你所从事的是一个高度依赖人际互动的行业，这意味着事情并不总能按计划进行。

sentences.text: holly : I guess it's being prepared to make changes that matters.
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 我想，关键在于随时准备好做出调整。

sentences.text: tutor : That's right.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 没错。

sentences.text: You may have to make an on-the-spot change to a timetable because of a problem you hadn't anticipated …
sentences.zh: 你可能需要根据一个未曾预料到的问题，当场对时间表作出调整……

sentences.text: holly : … just do it!
sentences.zh: HOLLY: ……那就立刻执行！

sentences.text: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.text: tutor : How's your time management these days?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 你最近的时间管理能力如何？

sentences.text: holly : I'm working on it – I'm certainly better when I have a deadline, which is why this work suits me.
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 我正在努力提升——当然，在有截止期限的情况下我表现得确实更好，这也是这份工作适合我的原因。

sentences.text: tutor : Yes, but it's how you respond as that deadline approaches!
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，但更重要的是，当截止期限临近时你如何应对！

sentences.text: holly : I know I've got to look calm even if I'm in a panic.
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 我知道，即使内心慌乱，外表也必须保持镇定。

sentences.text: tutor : Just think to yourself – no one must know I'm under pressure.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 时刻提醒自己——绝不能让别人看出我正承受压力。

sentences.text: holly : Yeah – even though I'm multi-tasking like crazy!
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 是啊——尽管我实际上正疯狂地同时处理多项任务！

sentences.text: tutor : Another skill that events managers need is creativity.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 活动经理所需的另一项技能是创造力。

sentences.text: Often your client has what we call the ‘big picture' idea, but it's up to the events manager to think of all the fine points that go to making it work .
sentences.zh: 通常客户会有一个我们称之为‘宏观构想’的想法，但具体落实这一构想的所有细节，则需由活动经理来思考和安排。

sentences.text: holly : Right, so I need to listen carefully to that idea and then fill in all the gaps .
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 明白了，所以我需要认真倾听这个构想，然后把所有细节都补充完善。

sentences.text: tutor : That's right.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 没错。

sentences.text: And you'll have a team working under you, so another key skill is leadership.
sentences.zh: 而且你手下会有一支团队，因此另一项关键技能是领导力。

sentences.text: Your team may have lots of ideas too, but you've got to make the ultimate choices.
sentences.zh: 你的团队成员也可能提出许多想法，但最终决策权仍在你手中。

sentences.text: Do we have refreshments inside or out, for example?
sentences.zh: 例如，茶点是在室内还是室外提供？

sentences.text: holly : Isn't it better to be democratic?
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 难道实行民主决策不是更好吗？

sentences.text: tutor : It's a nice idea, but you have the ultimate responsibility.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 这是个不错的设想，但最终责任仍由你承担。

sentences.text: So, believe in what you think best .
sentences.zh: 所以，请相信你自己认为最佳的方案。

sentences.text: Be prepared to say ‘yes', that's a good idea but it won't work here.
sentences.zh: 要敢于说：‘是的，这是个好主意，但在此情境下行不通。’

sentences.text: holly : I see what you mean.
sentences.zh: holly：我明白你的意思。

sentences.text: What about the networking side of things?
sentences.zh: 那网络关系这一块呢？

sentences.text: I know it's an area that a lot of students worry about because we don't have much experience to offer others.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是很多学生担心的领域，因为我们没什么经验可以分享给他人。

sentences.text: tutor : But even without it – you can still be an interesting person with useful ideas.
sentences.zh: tutor：但即便没有经验——你依然可以成为一个有趣的人，并拥有实用的想法。

sentences.text: And the more people you impress, the better.
sentences.zh: 你给越多的人留下深刻印象，效果就越好。

sentences.text: holly : I guess that will help me when I apply for a real job.
sentences.zh: holly：我想这对我申请真正的工作会有帮助。

sentences.text: tutor : Exactly – think ahead – remember what your ambitions are and keep them in mind.
sentences.zh: tutor：没错——要未雨绸缪——牢记自己的志向，并始终将其放在心上。

sentences.text: holly : Definitely.
sentences.zh: holly：确实如此。

sentences.text: Scientists believe that a majority of the earth's bird population migrate in some fashion or other.
sentences.zh: 科学家认为，地球上大多数鸟类种群均以某种方式迁徙。

sentences.text: Some travel seasonally for relatively short distances, such as birds that move from their winter habitats in lowlands to mountain tops for the summers.
sentences.zh: 有些鸟类季节性地进行相对较短距离的迁徙，例如冬季栖息于低地、夏季则飞往山顶的鸟类。

sentences.text: Others, like the Arctic Tern, travel more than 25,000 miles seasonally between the northern and southern poles.
sentences.zh: 而另一些鸟类，如北极燕鸥，则每年在北极与南极之间往返迁徙超过25,000英里。

sentences.text: Bird migration has been studied over many centuries through a variety of observations.
sentences.zh: 数个世纪以来，人们通过多种观察方式研究鸟类迁徙。

sentences.text: But until relatively recently, where birds went to in the winter was considered something of a mystery.
sentences.zh: 但直到相对近期，鸟类冬季去向仍被视为某种谜团。

sentences.text: The lack of modern science and technology led to many theories that we now recognize as error-filled and even somewhat amusing.
sentences.zh: 现代科学与技术的缺乏导致了许多如今被我们认定为充满谬误、甚至略显滑稽的理论。

sentences.text: Take hibernation theory for example – two thousand years ago, it was commonly believed that when birds left an area, they went underwater to hibernate in the seas and oceans.
sentences.zh: 以冬眠理论为例——两千年前，人们普遍相信鸟类离开某地后会潜入水下，在海洋中冬眠。

sentences.text: Another theory for the regular appearance and disappearance of birds was that they spent winter hidden in mud till the weather changed and food became abundant again.
sentences.zh: 另一种解释鸟类周期性出现与消失的理论认为：它们冬季藏身于泥中，待天气转暖、食物再度丰足时才现身。

sentences.text: The theory that some birds hibernate persisted until experiments were done on caged birds in the 1940s which demonstrated that birds have no hibernation instinct.
sentences.zh: 部分鸟类会冬眠的理论一直延续至20世纪40年代，直到人们在笼养鸟类身上开展实验，证实鸟类根本不具备冬眠本能，该理论才被推翻。

sentences.text: One of the earliest naturalists and philosophers from ancient Greece was Aristotle who was the first writer to discuss the disappearance and reappearance of some bird species at certain times of year.
sentences.zh: 古希腊最早的自然学家与哲学家之一亚里士多德，是首位撰文探讨某些鸟类物种在一年中特定时节消失又重现现象的作家。

sentences.text: He developed the theory of transmutation, the seasonal change of one species into another, by observing redstarts and robins.
sentences.zh: 他通过观察红尾鸲与知更鸟，提出了‘转化论’——即一种鸟类随季节变化而转变为另一种物种。

sentences.text: He observed that in the autumn, small birds called ‘redstarts' began to lose their feathers , which convinced Aristotle that they changed into robins for the winter, and back into redstarts in the summer.
sentences.zh: 他观察到秋季时一种名为‘红尾鸲’的小型鸟类开始脱落羽毛，由此确信它们冬季变为知更鸟，夏季再变回红尾鸲。

sentences.text: These assumptions are understandable given that this pair of species are similar in shape, but are a classic example of an incorrect interpretation based on correct observations.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这两种鸟类外形相似，这些假设不难理解；但它们恰恰是‘基于正确观察却得出错误结论’的经典范例。

sentences.text: The most bizarre theory was put forward by an English amateur scientist, Charles Morton, in the seventeenth century.
sentences.zh: 最离奇的理论由17世纪一位英国业余科学家查尔斯·莫顿提出。

sentences.text: He wrote a surprisingly well-regarded paper claiming that birds migrate to the moon and back every year.
sentences.zh: 他撰写了一篇出人意料地广受推崇的论文，声称鸟类每年往返月球一次。

sentences.text: He came to this conclusion as the only logical explanation for the total disappearance of some species.
sentences.zh: 他得出这一结论，是因为这是当时唯一能逻辑自洽地解释某些鸟类彻底消失现象的假说。

sentences.text: One of the key moments in the development of migration theory came in 1822 when a white stork was shot in Germany.
sentences.zh: 鸟类迁徙理论发展史上的一个关键节点出现在1822年，当时一只白鹳在德国被射杀。

sentences.text: This particular stork made history because of the long spear in its neck which incredibly had not killed it – everyone immediately realised this spear was definitely not European.
sentences.zh: 这只白鹳载入史册，是因为其颈部插着一支长矛——令人难以置信的是，它竟未因此丧命；人们立刻意识到这支长矛绝非欧洲制造。

sentences.text: It turned out to be a spear from a tribe in Central Africa.
sentences.zh: 后来证实，这支长矛源自中非某部落。

sentences.text: This was a truly defining moment in the history of ornithology because it was the first evidence that storks spend their winters in sub-Saharan Africa .
sentences.zh: 这确实是鸟类学史上具有里程碑意义的时刻，因为这是首次确凿证明白鹳冬季栖息于撒哈拉以南非洲的证据。

sentences.text: You can still see the ‘arrow stork' in the Zoological Collection of the University of Rostock in Germany.
sentences.zh: 如今，人们仍可在德国罗斯托克大学动物学收藏馆中看到这只‘带箭白鹳’。

sentences.text: People gradually became aware that European birds moved south in autumn and north in summer but didn't know much about it until the practice of catching birds and putting rings on their legs became established.
sentences.zh: 人们逐渐意识到欧洲鸟类秋季南迁、春季北返，但对此知之甚少，直至‘捕鸟环志’（即捕捉鸟类并在其腿部套上金属环）的做法得以普及。

sentences.text: Before this, very little information was available about the actual destinations of particular species and how they travelled there.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，关于特定鸟类实际目的地及其迁徙路径的信息极为匮乏。

sentences.text: People speculated that larger birds provided a kind of taxi service for smaller birds by carrying them on their backs.
sentences.zh: 人们曾推测大型鸟类会充当小型鸟类的‘空中出租车’，驮着它们飞行。

sentences.text: This idea came about because it seemed impossible that small birds weighing only a few grams could fly over vast oceans .
sentences.zh: 这种想法源于一个看似合理的困惑：仅重几克的小型鸟类似乎不可能飞越浩瀚大洋。

sentences.text: This idea was supported by observations of bird behaviour such as the harassment of larger birds by smaller birds.
sentences.zh: 该观点还得到一些鸟类行为观察的支持，例如小型鸟类骚扰大型鸟类的现象。

sentences.text: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts The development of bird ringing, by a Danish schoolteacher, Hans Christian Cornelius Mortensen, made many discoveries possible.
sentences.zh: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 听力原文：丹麦教师汉斯·克里斯蒂安·科尼利厄斯·莫滕森开创的鸟类环志法，使诸多发现成为可能。

sentences.text: This is still common practice today and relies upon what is known as ‘recovery' – this is when ringed birds are found dead in the place they have migrated to, and identified.
sentences.zh: 这一方法至今仍被广泛采用，其核心在于所谓‘回收’——即环志鸟在其迁徙目的地死亡后被发现并识别。

sentences.text: Huge amounts of data were gathered in the early part of the twentieth century and for the first time in history people understood where birds actually went to in winter.
sentences.zh: 20世纪早期积累了海量数据，人类历史上首次真正弄清了鸟类冬季的实际去向。

sentences.text: In 1931, an atlas was published showing where the most common species of European birds migrated to.
sentences.zh: 1931年，一本图集出版，标示出欧洲最常见鸟类的越冬地点。

sentences.text: More recent theories about bird migration …
sentences.zh: 关于鸟类迁徙的更新近理论……
